Chapter 6708: Divine Beast’S Ultimate Form

Chapter 6708: Divine Beast’s Ultimate Form

When this new being opened his eyes, tribulations appeared all over space. This included Three Immortals, Eight Desolaces, the six continents, Heaven Realm, and other worlds...

As he slowly stood up, everything became distant, akin to the gap between worlds and the high heaven. Reaching the high heaven was impossible enough, let alone fighting it.

Supreme overlords failed to take a close look at this ethereal being. An immortal unleashing their most powerful attack with their best weapon could find the strike only a thread’s breadth away from him. However, this tiny gap would grow infinitely farther in the blink of an eye.

“High Heaven Infinity Strike.” The being grabbed a galaxy containing countless stars as if it were a pebble and threw it at Li Qiye.

Li Qiye used all the previously seen divine gifts and still couldn’t dodge it. This heavenly body had escaped all constraints of the mortal world and had absolute control. It was numerous times more powerful than when separated.

It smashed Li Qiye from one dimension to another, crushing everything along the way. This exceeded the overlords’ imagination and ability to keep up. Immortals themselves barely comprehended the fight.

“Bam!” He broke through ten dimensions and made them collapse.

“Sacred Teacher, perhaps it is time to use your dao heart.” The fused being said, feeling the greatest might in existence and realizing the gap before.

“Too soon for that.” Li Qiye smiled and said: “Myriad Beasts.”

Immortals saw Li Qiye’s body shaking a bit, affecting all worlds. Even the fused heavenly body vibrated.

An old world appeared once more. It might have been older than the primordial and before the emergence of the high heaven.

“Raa!” Perfect and adult divine beasts leaped up from this world.

True dragon, kun peng, gluttonous beast, qilin, shapeshifting serpent, phoenix...

When Li Qiye derived the beasts’ gifts to the limit, he created this world.

“Ultimate comprehension.” Taichu became startled.

“Yes.” Li Qiye smiled.

“If this is the limit of the beasts, what is the limit of the primodials?” Evil Transformation asked.

“He derived it.” Li Qiye said: “I did the divine beasts.”

Meanwhile, the beasts in this world activated their gifts. Since they shared the same source as the primordial immortals, they were just as strong.

They fused and formed a primal chaos beast.

“Not good.” Taichu remarked while staring at it.

This was the ultimate form of the divine beasts - Chaos. Its gift shared the same name.

Chaos attacked with an unknown affinity. Perhaps similar to the high heaven, it controlled time, reincarnation, karma, primordial, and everything else.

It existed when the high heaven was still an infant, cowering before its bloody jaws.

“High Heaven Seal.” The heavenly being used the purest heavenly affinity. The world had never seen anything like this.

It possessed both annihilation and creation, something beyond the celestial immortal realm. However, Chaos was older and more powerful.

“Boom!” The heavenly being was blown away. This was not a matter of moving from one space to another but rather, it blasted the being from the primordial era to the present.

Meanwhile, Li Qiye in his Chaos form was still in the timeline before the birth of the high heaven.

“So this is Chaos.” The heavenly being stood up and vomited blood.
